name: Chimerist
info: Increase MP by 5. You may perform Ritualism.

data.name: Consume
data.description: After you deal damage to one or more creatures with a spell, if you have an `arcane`, `dagger` or `flail` weapon equipped, you recover`【SL × 2】`Mind Points.

data.name: Feral Speech
data.description: You can communicate with creatures of the `beast`, `monster` and `plant` Species.

data.name: Pathogenesis
data.description: When you deal damage to one or more creatures with one of your Chimerist spells, each of those creatures that share their `Species` with the creature you originally learned that spell from suffers `poisoned`.

data.name: Ritual Chimerism
data.description: You may perform Rituals whose effects fall within the `Chimerism` discipline. When you acquire this Skill, choose`【INS + WLP】or【MIG + WLP】`. From now on, your Chimerism Rituals will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check.

data.name: Spell Mimic
data.description:
After a `beast`, `monster`, or `plant` creature you can see casts a spell and resolves its effects, you may learn that spell as a Chimerist spell of your own; if you do, record the `Species` of the creature you learned it from.

When you first acquire this Skill, choose`【INS + WLP】or【MIG + WLP】`. From now on, your offensive (*ϟ*) Chimerist spells will use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check, regardless of the Attributes used by the creature you learned the spell from.

You may have up to`【SL + 2】different Chimerist spells` memorized this way. If you want to memorize a new Chimerist spell but are already at your limit, you must forget one of your old spells and replace it with the new spell.

data.name: Spell Buffet
data.description:
*This variant allows for a different playstyle, an homage to Quina's gameplay in Final Fantasy 9. Treat this Skill's name as "Spell Mimic" for the sake of Heroic Skill requirements. If you use this variant, you cannot acquire the `Chimeric Mastery` Heroic Skill.*

You always know which among the non-humanoid enemies you can see have current Hit Points equal to or lower than`【15 + half your level】`. During a conflict, you may use an action to choose one of those enemies: if you do, that enemy is reduced to 0 Hit Points and the Game Master reveals all spells they know. Then, you may learn any number of those spells as Chimerist spells of your own; if you do, record the `Species` of the enemy you learned them from.

When you first acquire this Skill, choose`【INS + WLP】or【MIG + WLP】`. From now on, your offensive (*ϟ*) Chimerist spells use the chosen Attributes for the Magic Check, regardless of the Attributes used by the creatures you learned those spells from.

You may have up to`【SL + 4】different Chimerist spells` memorized this way. If you want to memorize a new Chimerist spell but are already at your limit, you must forget one of your old spells and replace it with the new spell.
